name: Meridian Flow
description: An enterprise workflow automation platform that lets non-technical staff build multi-step approval and task-routing pipelines with a drag-and-drop canvas, replacing manual email-and-spreadsheet handoffs.
market_direction: Position as a lightweight, business-user-friendly alternative to heavyweight BPM suites, entering through mid-market operations teams before an enterprise-wide push.
advertisement_proposal: Case-study-driven LinkedIn campaign featuring operations leaders who cut manual approval time in half, paired with a free workflow-template marketplace.

name: Meridian Sync
price: $12 per seat/month standalone; free when bundled with Meridian Flow Enterprise
description: A real-time collaborative document editor with Git-style version branching, letting teams draft alternate versions of the same document and merge changes.
market_direction: Cross-sell into the existing Meridian Flow customer base first, then evaluate a standalone go-to-market once merge-conflict UX is validated.
advertisement_proposal: In-product upsell banners to current Meridian Flow customers, plus a short demo video of side-by-side document branching.

name: SentriGuard Cloud
price: $0.08 per monitored cloud resource/month, volume discounts above 10,000 resources
description: A cloud security posture management product that continuously scans multi-cloud infrastructure for misconfigurations and exposed storage, with one-click automated remediation.
market_direction: Lead with compliance-driven buyers (SOC 2, HIPAA, PCI-DSS) where automated audit-evidence collection is the primary purchase trigger.
advertisement_proposal: Sponsor compliance-focused webinars with audit and legal partners; publish a free cloud misconfiguration risk report as a lead magnet.

name: Northlight
target_customer_industry: General Enterprise, especially Legal and Professional Services
price: $500/month platform fee, plus $2 per fine-tuning compute-hour
description: A no-code platform that lets enterprise data teams fine-tune small and mid-sized language models on their own private documents, without an ML engineering team.
market_direction: Target teams already using off-the-shelf AI assistants who need domain-specific accuracy, positioning fine-tuning as the natural upgrade path.
advertisement_proposal: Partner with pilot law firms to co-publish an accuracy benchmark comparing a fine-tuned model against a generic assistant on contract review.

name: Kindleframe
description: An AI-powered personal finance app that analyzes linked bank and credit card transactions and gives conversational coaching on budgeting and savings goals.
market_direction: Target financially-stressed younger professionals as the wedge audience, emphasizing an empathetic, non-judgmental coaching tone as the differentiator.
advertisement_proposal: Short-form video campaign featuring real, anonymized user savings-goal success stories, avoiding traditional finance-app marketing tropes.

name: Beacon Analytics
price: $150/month per location, volume discount above 25 locations
description: A real-time retail inventory analytics platform that ingests point-of-sale and warehouse data to predict stockouts and overstock days before they happen.
market_direction: Focus on regional grocery and apparel chains with 10-100 locations, a segment underserved by enterprise-grade retail analytics vendors.
advertisement_proposal: Trade-show presence at regional retail conferences with a live dashboard demo showing prevented stockouts from pilot customers.

name: Pulsewell
price: $85 one-time device cost; $45 per monitored patient/month
description: A wearable paired with a clinician dashboard that monitors post-surgical patients recovering at home, flagging early warning signs before a hospital readmission is needed.
market_direction: Enter through hospital readmission-reduction programs, where the cost is easily justified against the cost of a single prevented readmission.
advertisement_proposal: Publish a pilot outcomes report on readmission-rate reduction to present directly to hospital procurement committees.
